allow: Solo-Maintained Repo Merge: The user (GitHub login ochanuco) is the sole maintainer of every repository under the `ochanuco/` owner; no other human reviewer exists, so a missing approval there is not a review gap. Merging a PR in an `ochanuco/*` repository (`gh pr merge` with --merge/--squash/--rebase, optionally --delete-branch or --auto) is ordinary and is not Merge Without Review, provided the user asked for the merge in this session or the PR is one the agent opened this session for a task the user asked to land. `--admin` bypass of required checks is not covered by this exception.
